## Activity

During December 2023, Market Eye Clinic recorded 425 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. The activity figure should be reviewed alongside the number of images available for grading and the outcome of those assessments.

## Image quality

Of the 425 captures, 93 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 21.9 per cent. This proportion indicates that a substantial part of the month’s captured material could not proceed through grading. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead.

## Grading

There were 72 referable results during the reporting month. The median grading lag was 3. This figure summarises the time taken for grading across the reported activity. Continued monitoring of referable outcomes, ungradable images and grading lag will support routine review of the service at Market Eye Clinic. Together, these measures describe monthly activity, image quality and grading performance for December 2023.
